reviews.text: I’ve been having a really good time with SCAD so far. The atmosphere is great and does a good job pulling you into the world. There’s a solid variety of enemies, skills, and weapons, which keeps the gameplay feeling fresh and fun. Overall, it’s been an enjoyable experience and definitely worth checking out if you like this kind of game.
I love the art style and overall gore elements. The game loop is addictive and fun. The content seems a lot which is a good plus. Overall pretty good. A very good addition to the genre.

Good amount of fun for a small scope survival-like game! There's some tweaks I would make to rewards on some of the missions, and a couple other small things, but this is solid fun for the price point. Will leave some feedback on the dev's Discord. Thanks dev! [url=https://www.youtube.com/live/SIQCJe3GxTU] Live Stream [/url]

S.C.A.D. takes the traditional Vampire Survivors formula and makes it even more fun by backing it up with some genuinely innovative elements. With 16 different maps and a ton of unique upgradable items, it offers a surprisingly deep and highly customizable experience. I've only just managed to beat the first two bosses, but it looks like I'll be sinking many more hours into this. The developers pushed out several update patches within just a few hours, and they are consistently working on improving the game and adding new content. The Naisu team is incredibly reliable and you can clearly tell they are putting a lot of meticulous care into their work

SCAD is a fun and promising game with a cool post-apocalyptic world. The hovercraft combat feels satisfying and the upgrades make you want to keep playing. For an Early Access game it already feels like it has a lot of potential.
I've been waiting for this game for a while, and it was absolutely worth the wait. Driving a hovercraft and blasting zombies is a great combination. The pixel art looks fantastic too. Great work!

Got to play this for a couple hours earlier, really enjoying it so far. I honestly feel like more games need attack hovercrafts. If you like roguelikes, you'll probably enjoy this one. Looking forward to seeing where this goes in early access.
Vampire survivors like game with pretty good amount of variety and buildcraft options, with only a few bugs, also runs well. Had fun for the short time i played.
Very good game concept but need a lot of work to fix bugs. I cannot recommend the game in this actual state. My recommendation: Wait until future patch notes before buying this game.

Likes: - Core loop is pretty fun - Different turrets and build options - Bossfights - Some skills Dislikes: - Game has some bugs, but its EA so... - It feels easier after mid-game - Some lack of direction The devs seem to be updating the game pretty often so I believe the game can shine. Its still not bad for its price range. I recommend it.
Overall though, the gameplay feels solid, chilling out and mowing down zombies with the hovercraft is pretty fun 😄

[h1]SCAD简评[/h1] [quote]关注小红瓶，回血在当下点击关注[url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45932802/] 小红瓶游戏评鉴组[/url][/quote] [h2] 个人游玩与体验 [/h2] 这是一款像素风格带有类幸存者玩法和肉鸽元素的游戏，游戏的美术风格非常有自己的特色，非常精致的像素风格的末日废土世界，有大量建模场景不同的地图，游戏现在是ea发售，虽然目前游戏没有支持中文，但是制作组已经明确说了会很快的加入中文，观望的朋友可以等待一下。 游戏的主要玩法就是小范围地图上面用气垫船扫射僵尸生存下去，这方面玩法类似于类幸存者玩法，在游戏里面我们可以给气垫船制作各种不同的武器，还可以购买新的气垫船，还能雇佣船员，游戏还带有肉鸽玩法，我们每次升级时都能选择随机能力的卡牌，游戏内容丰富度还是非常不错的，战斗还可以组成很多种bd，还有不错的boss战体验，前面游玩体验还是非常不错的，扫射僵尸也非常解压，不过游戏在ea阶段，现在游玩的时候还是有些bug，比如玩的时候偶尔会遇到画面问题，还有游戏指引说明也需要优化一下。 游戏整体还是可以的，而且游戏本身的定价也不贵，在后面推出中文之后，应该会有更多的人来体验游玩，推荐给喜欢这种像素风格和带有类幸存者肉鸽玩法的玩家去游玩体验一下。 欢迎加入:[url=https://steamcommunity.com/groups/xiaohongping] 小红瓶游戏评鉴组[/url]

The game brings itself back up upon reaching the main menu if I send it down during launch. If an app is sent to background for whatever reason, it's supposed to stay there and not demand attention unless it has a very good reason to. This was absolutely disrespectful. Uninstalled.

If you love action roguelites like Vampire Survivors or Brotato, but want something with unique mechanics, SCAD is a breath of fresh air. Instead of the usual fantasy heroes, you pilot a highly customizable hovercraft to crush massive zombie hordes. • Hovercraft Mechanics: Driving and drifting around enemies feels extremely smooth and dynamic. • The Loop (Salvage, Craft, Destroy): The upgrading system during expeditions keeps the gameplay loop highly addictive. • Gorgeous Pixel Art: The post-apocalyptic isometric world looks beautiful and full of detail with plenty of weapon variety and intense boss fights.

really rocky start with this one: not thrilled when i have to change the resolution on my monitor just to play a game that allegedly supports UWHD. not thrilled when i have to restart an entire chapter (which consists of multiple levels) when i die during the boss fight. not thrilled that i HAVE to spend money to repair the hovercraft to proceed but because of the exorbitant costs, i never have enough to upgrade the hovercraft without replaying chapters. tedious. suggested fixes: 1. either don't advertise UWHD support within the resolution settings or make DAMN sure that it works 2. reset the LEVEL upon death not the CHAPTER - the replayability factor isn't high enough for that. 3. half the cost of the upgrades. Luckily, i purchased this game at a DEEP discount and i appreciate what the devs are trying to do (the concept and pixel aesthetic reminds me a bit of THEY ARE BILLIONS) and so i stuck it out. Much to my delight, there seems to be a pretty awesome game underneath the hopefully-soon-to-be-discarded shavings and excess jank of early-access. All of that being said, my criticisms are more nitpickings and there will be many who will absolutely enjoy the experience in its current state. update: because the game cannot be played in ultrawide screen and thus i had to play it in a small window, it was nearly impossible to utilize the hook mechanic. i kept accidentally clicking outside of the window, accidentally minimalizing the screen, and exiting the program...as such, it was impossible for me to progress. as the game is currently in an unplayable state for owners of UWHD monitors (such as myself), i cannot in good conscious recommend it.
Очень драйвовый экшен с приятным пиксельным стилем и огромными ордами врагов. Постоянные улучшения транспорта и оружия делают каждую вылазку зрелищной и по-настоящему веселой. Крайне залипательно.
An action‑packed, post‑apocalyptic roguelite where you pilot a customizable hovercraft. Fight relentless zombie hordes, craft and upgrade powerful weapons, and gear up for the future expeditions.
SCAD is super fun for an indie. The pixel art is well done and the actual gameplay is fast paced and never boring.
S.C.A.D is a simple, loud, immediately satisfying roguelite that turns your hovercraft into a rolling fortress of guns.
SCAD is an action-packed roguelike game in which we control a hovercraft and destroy hordes of various zombies and bosses in several locations.
